blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The credibility of Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano has been mocked by Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday after the former described Lacson as having influence over various government agencies amid the controversy over alleged ghost projects in Taguig City. Cayetano was quoted by Lacson, in a post on X, as saying he had become “Chief Justice Lacson, Prosecutor Lacson, DOJ Lacson, persecutor Lacson” and “Secretary Lacson,” who was supposedly “calling the shots.” Lacson said, “If this were coming from someone credible, I’d take it as a compliment.” His statement came after Cayetano in a Facebook livestream […]...
